purpose: Document primary local registry/custody evidence and bounded anonymous full-geometry discovery.
assessment: The city geoportal was reachable, but no city-specific parcel feature layer or local registry custodian was verified. National BHUMI documentation is not substituted for a local source. No full-geometry query was made because no target city parcel layer was identified.
registryAssessment: The official Gorontalo City Geoportal identifies itself as a city node in Indonesia’s spatial-data network, administered by Bappeda. Its catalog/service description is general geospatial information; it did not establish local cadastral/title-record custody or expose a parcel layer. National BHUMI/ATR-BPN material is not used to infer city-local custody.
